evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Joanna: 'It might take about ten to fifteen minutes if this is a good time.' / Konrad: 'Yup, sounds good.' — framing present but no wait for explicit yes before pivoting into agenda question.

No customer-raised concerns surfaced later either, so N/A credit applies.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment/house): yes. Floor/stories: yes (third floor, no elevator). Number of rooms: yes (two bedrooms + guest room). Walking distance: yes (40-50 feet to stairs, two flights). Additional rooms: yes (guest room, outdoor chair). Special considerations: yes (4-foot mirror noted, stairs weight limit). Additional stops: yes (Round Rock house, 15-20 boxes only).

evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Joanna: 'typically for a three bedroom apartment, usually we end up having about 404040 to fifty boxes. Do you think you would just fall within that range or do you think you'll have more?' — yes, asked.

Later: 'I'll quote you for an eight to eight and a half hour mark, which is an estimated budget of 207,250¢' — anchored to typical range and personalized to this customer's extra items (desk, bed, side tables) plus travel time between two stops and stairs logistics. Full.

evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Joanna: 'no worries damage coverage which would give you up to $20.001 million coverage for any repair, replacement reimbursement for any accidental damages.' — The $2,000 coverage amount is garbled in transcription ('$20.001 million' is clearly a transcription error for $2,000), but no-deductible/no-fine-print framing was not explicitly stated. Partial.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: After Two Promises, Joanna did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar confirmation. She moved into the explicit ask. False.

evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No recognizable version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' was asked. False.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Joanna: 'would you like us to help for your move on the 15th of November so we can get you on the schedule?' — clear, plain ask with no softening or built-in out. Full.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Joanna: 'We don't take deposits at this time. No reason securing as pot as well. If you ended up, you know, making changes to it. Just let us know ahead of time.' — rate lock/no-deposit framing present. True.

top_strength: Joanna gathered exceptionally thorough logistics details across property type, floor layout, walking distances, special items (mirror), and multi-stop routing, setting up a highly accurate estimate that personalized to the customer's actual move complexity and prior history.
coaching_note: Insert a genuine 'Does that feel fair?' pause after pricing, ask the real 'What's still concerning you?' not 'Any questions?' at Section 6, and confirm phone number and final crew notes summary at the booking step.
